name: Ground Beef & Mixed Veggie Bake with Mashed Potato Topping

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a large bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add beef and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until just browned, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: While the beef cooks, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add veggies and spices to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 5-6 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add milk, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml whole milk
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are soft, add flour and cook, stirring frequently, 1-2 minutes more.

Add tomato sauce, broth, peas, and Worcestershire to the pot with the beef; stir to combine the beef filling and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat and transfer filling to a large baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups frozen peas
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Spoon mashed potatoes over the beef filling; using a fork, evenly spread mashed potatoes over the top, creating ridges.
Place baking dish in the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the bake between plates or bowls and enjoy!
